note: Hand-maintained catalog. Add a game, then run: node darkhearts/scripts/build-cabinet.mjs

games.title: HOLLOWMARK
games.tagline: Ashes of the Warden Crown — Rook, before the list.
games.blurb: Third-person action platformer: double-jump and dash traversal, the Splitfang's four swappable cores, a Hollow transformation fed by kills, and a Vat-Thing boss.
games.controlsNote: WASD move, mouse look (click to lock pointer), Space jump, Shift dash, LMB fire, Q/E swap core, F melee, T Hollow form, R reload.
games.vrNote: Camera look is driven by real pointer-lock mouse movement. A VR room's laser pointer or gaze cursor can hit the cabinet UI and the in-game HUD buttons, but it cannot drive the look camera — a player needs a physical mouse (or the room's controller-to-mouse bridge) to move the camera once inside the game.

games.title: JAK PROJECT
games.tagline: OpenGOAL engine — the studio's fork, rebuilt from source.
games.blurb: Our fork of the OpenGOAL reverse-engineered Jak & Daxter engine: the GOAL compiler (goalc), decompiler, and native game runtime (gk), built as desktop binaries. The engine is open source; in-game assets are extracted from a player's own legally-owned copy of the game — none ship with this fork.
games.buildNote: cmake --preset Release-linux-gcc && cmake --build build/Release/bin. Needs gcc/g++, cmake, ninja, nasm, and X11/GL/pulse dev headers (docs/setup/system/linux.md).
games.vrNote: Native desktop app, not a browser page — a VR room cannot load it as a browser texture. To play it inside Amber Den or a similar room, run gk on the host machine and mirror it onto a room surface via a desktop-capture/stream panel. HOLLOWMARK stays the studio's own IP and evolves in parallel; nothing from this fork's world merges into it.
